notes:
What's new in 0.1.113:
- Connection settings: a relay card now shows your saved choice correctly, and its buttons act on that saved choice. A failed attempt to turn a relay off refreshes the card instead of leaving it wrong. The card for your own relay no longer assumes which company runs it.
- Mini player: it keeps track of the right title when playback changes, old playback work no longer overwrites what is playing now, and a newer saved place in a paused episode is no longer lost. Pressing Play on the podcast episode that is already loaded keeps the sound and its place.
- Library search: a saved search address now fills in your search words everywhere it appears, not only the first place. The library loading status uses evenly spaced numbers and stays on one line when it fits.
- Live TV: if the guide or the channel library cannot load, it says so and offers a Retry button that retries only that part.
- Preparing a title ahead of time: the quality choice stays locked while Start is still working, and a late answer for an earlier title can no longer change the screen.
- Podcasts: a show that fails to open has a Retry button, and an old error banner clears once the show loads. The actor lists in Movies and TV Shows can be retried after a failed lookup, and the Trailers actor search keeps up with quick typing.
- Playlists and Music: the Add to playlist picker copes better with quick changes, a playlist plays the choice you made last, and pressing the same mix twice no longer starts it twice.
- Offline chip: each one has its own panel, and a saved status that is incomplete is hidden. Messages from the watchlist button, the featured film card and the artwork picker stay with the title they were for.
- Browser player: when a daily watching limit stops a film, a short notice now explains why and says the time starts again tomorrow. Only the notice is new; the limit works as before.
- Settings: the email notification fields have room and visible labels, and the email password label is only shown when there is a box for it. The licence screen shows the installed Electron version.
- Languages: the reasons shown when hardware video conversion fails are now translated, some French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese leftovers are fixed, and long translated labels wrap in tables and on Home.
- Known issue: Prepare for streaming can fail with "This title could not be found" when a film and its converted copy share a name. Nothing is changed or deleted.
- Tested on one PC with a test library, plus automated tests and code review. The phone app and Beebo Auto are not part of this release.
- Release source commit 4ba5b1d02.
- Built: Nov 3, 2026, 12:57 PM Eastern.
- Published: Nov 3, 2026, 1:41 PM Eastern.
